title: pr-comment review draft
description: Every text field is untrusted, agent-generated text. A draft file is at most 16 MiB; text fields at most 64 KiB of UTF-8 each. Checks a schema cannot express (unique ids, start_line < line, byte caps) are made by pr-comment and draft check.

schema_version.description: pr-comment refuses any version it does not know (exit 2 unsupported_draft_version).

pr.description: host/<full project path>#N. Compared with forgectl show's pr (host and path in ASCII lowercase); a different PR that is not the same pr_id exits 2 draft_pr_mismatch.

head_sha.description: The head the findings' lines refer to.

base_ref.description: Untrusted: the base branch name the draft was written against.

base_sha.description: The base branch tip at drafting time; informational.

merge_base_sha.description: forgectl diff --json merge_base_sha at drafting time; used for left-side findings on re-anchor.

event.description: approve is never a draft event; see review --approve.

body.description: Untrusted: the review's summary text; may be empty.

path.description: Untrusted: the path as forgectl files or diff prints it at the anchor head; head-side for both sides. One line (pr-comment matches the whole string); at most 4096 bytes, checked by pr-comment.

line.description: 1-based. null makes a file-level finding, which always goes to the review body.

start_line.description: start_line < line, same side; checked by pr-comment, not by this schema.

side.description: right: the head's version; left: the base's version at the merge-base.

title.description: Untrusted: one line of short text for the bold prefix; trimmed, and an empty title counts as absent.

body.description: Untrusted: the finding's text; at most 64 KiB of UTF-8, checked by pr-comment (maxLength counts code points).

items.description: Untrusted: one raw replacement line: no line terminator or other forgectl separator (pr-comment matches the whole string).

lines.description: Replacement code for start_line..line, one string per line; [] suggests deleting the range. The whole suggestion is at most 64 KiB, checked by pr-comment.

suggestion.description: Only on side right with a line.

findings.description: Finding ids are unique across findings and unanchored; checked by pr-comment, not by this schema.

unanchored.description: Optional: findings that could not be anchored, with the anchor they last had and their moved reason. Never mapped or validated; always rendered in the body's 'Findings that could not be anchored' section. At most 500 together with findings, checked by pr-comment.

meta.description: Untrusted: free-form producer data; pr-comment ignores it. The only place extra properties are allowed.
